LESSON: INITIATING A CLASS INCOME

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social 2.2 Enterprise projects By the end of the sub-strand, the  In groups, le
Topic 2.2.2: Initiating a class income

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Initiating a class income. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. participate in the and be guided to carry them out management of the class respectively in initiating the selected income generating activity project

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. participate in the and be guided to carry them out management of the class respectively in initiating the selected income generating activity project
   In simple words: practise until you can participate in the and be guided to carry them out management of the class respectively in initiating the selected income generating activity project. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Initiating a class income using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Initiating a class income in the examples.
2. Explain Initiating a class income to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Initiating a class income.
4. Show that you can: participate in the and be guided to carry them out management of the class respectively in initiating the selected income generating activity project

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Initiating a class income using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Initiating a class income important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. participate in the and be guided to carry them out management of the class respectively in initiating the selected income generating activity project

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
